title: Manipur CM Yumnam Khemchand Attends State’s First-Ever ISL Match at Khuman Lampak
summary: Manipur CM Yumnam Khemchand Singh attends the state’s first-ever ISL match at Khuman Lampak, following a Marchathon promoting sports and fitness.
body:
Imphal, November 24, 2026: Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh attended the historic Indian Super League (ISL) match at Khuman Lampak Main Stadium on Tuesday evening, marking a significant moment for football enthusiasts and the sporting community in the state.

Ahead of the match, the Chief Minister led a Marchathon to the stadium alongside talented sportspersons, promoting sports, fitness and Manipur’s vibrant sporting culture. The march also marked the commencement of the next phase of the programme, with the distribution of ISL footballs and merchandise.

In a message, the Chief Minister reaffirmed the government’s commitment to nurturing sporting talent, encouraging greater youth participation and strengthening Manipur’s position as a hub of sporting excellence.

Describing the occasion as memorable, he said the match reflected Manipur’s deep-rooted love for football and the vibrant spirit of its youth.

The hosting of the state’s first-ever ISL match at Khuman Lampak Main Stadium marks an important milestone for Manipur’s football culture and provides a significant platform to celebrate the state’s passion for the sport.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
